neighbours.label: word stem that is about to take the suffix '-oid' (steroid, asteroid, spheroid, trapezoid)
fire: The doctor prescribed a corticosteroid cream for the rash.
Long-term use of anabolic steroids can harm the heart.
The probe landed on a giant asteroid last year.
The Earth is not a perfect sphere but an oblate spheroid.
The teeth are shaped like a trapezoid.
Exposure to corticosteroids can lead to glaucoma.
The robot in the film is a humanoid with silver skin.
Some lymph cells form an adenoid behind the nose.
quiet: The doctor prescribed a moisturizing cream for the rash.
Long-term use of strong painkillers can harm the liver.
The probe landed on a giant comet last year.
The Earth is not a perfect ball but slightly flattened.
The teeth are shaped like a square.
Exposure to bright sunlight can lead to cataracts.
The robot in the film is a machine with silver skin.
Some lymph cells form a gland behind the nose.

notes: Peaks on 'ero'/'o'/'pher'/'oster'/'z' right before 'oid'; the output promotes 'oid', 'oids', 'oidal'.
